proposed_capability: Correct source/event identity on paused passive observations so listener events cannot be mistaken for completed player-safe agent effects, and retain durable codification obligations until repository-level validation.
player_save_control_impact: No new capture mechanism, host OS hooks, screen input, player-save accesses, profile traversal or background monitoring; all observations use existing explicit authorized listener lane.

strategic_discrimination.parent_objective: Use agent computer control as a last resort, pause actions but retain listener while operator acts, automatically collect every observed action and turn it into deterministic, regression-tested repository logic.
rejected: Treat passive observation COMPLETED as a successful screen action
Close a codification requirement merely on an unverified commit reference
Install a background idle daemon or new desktop observer
strategic_discrimination.selected: Tag passive observation result source and preserve pending action identity; resume with fresh gates; keep codification receipts separately pending independent source verification.
strategic_discrimination.first_discriminating_test: Under active user input enqueue passive observation for the paused agent: observation completes, effect does not; after idle rechecks effect executes exactly once; outcome stays a distinct receipt.

expected_outcome: Passive listener can collect bounded evidence during player activity without falsely logging action completion; every controlled attempted effect remains visible as a codification or verification obligation.
negative_tests: Unexpected passive observation timeout cannot mark agent effect completed
Human active blocks effect but not reviewed passive observation
Resume after idle uses fresh scene and presence checks
Submitted code receipt is not merged/main proof
rollback_path: Revert small source/test additions; existing queue, listener and action flow remain.
unresolved_unknowns: Real installed Sims, trusted desktop idle sensor and native effect proof need local P08; GitHub branch/unit tests do not certify gameplay.
